objective: Under G18, at the coordinator's go-ahead after the owner asked to investigate further: the placements of FORBID-EDITS-20261126-001 where forbidding answers both readers' settings through a birth of two readers, and the two sampled starts where one edit changes the other reader's birth: does forbidding there give anything above the classical bound with free settings and no signalling, or is it signalling?
status: Complete 2026-11-26 (a negative with a reason; referee pending): in all 232 contact placements where forbidding answers both readers' settings, and at the two starts where one edit changes the other reader's birth, each reader's own births change with the far edit (signalling, readable with certainty); no table exceeds the classical bound.
title: The contact cases: forbidding that answers both readers through a shared birth
